description: Retrieve a document by ID as a text result containing its serialized document snapshot, canonical link, and revision. For large documents, metadata.complete is false and text provides retrieval instructions instead of content; use list_pages and read_page. Use get_document for a structured editable snapshot.

id.description: Document ID returned by search, list_documents, list_project_documents, or create_document; not its URL or slug.
